title: Not worth buying
text:
Not worth buying. One corner seam came apart on first wash. Not worth trouble of returning.

Udate: Second washing, another corner seam coming apart on the second sheet.

EASY CARE - Machine wash on cold. Tumble dry on low. Do not use bleach or use softeners

SLEEP BETTER - Wake up each morning feeling refreshed and full of energy. Best for any room in your house, dorm or hospital - bedroom, guest room, kids room, RV, vacation home. Great gift idea for men and women, Moms and Dads, Valentine's - Mother's - Father's Day and Christmas.
description: Crescent Bedding brings you 100% Cotton soft & comfy Fitted Bed Sheets at an affordable price. Enjoy & wrap up yourself in these carefully crafted 100% combed cotton cozy fitted sheets that are expertly manufactured for durability. These sheets are designed for dorm extra-long beds and fits mattresses of up to 15" deep. Fabric is mercerized for prolonged existence and pre-shrunk for shape retention. These sheets are easy care and can be washed and dried through use of ordinary washers and dryers which will not affect them. They are reactive dyed for colorfastness. They can also be hand washed. These are effective for people who have sensitive skin because they are 100% pure natural Indus valley cotton which gives soft sleeping surface that is good for your skin. Fitted sheets feature all-around elastic and deep pockets to fit your mattress. This is available in multiple sizes and colors letting you choose the one that can best suit your bedroom's interiors and fits your bed. Match your fitted sheet easily with other Crescent Bedding products, such as Flat Sheet, Pillow Cases, Pillow Shams, body pillow cases and Bed Skirts.
